## Effective sample size of the posterior mean (relative efficiency)
```{r nstar-learning-curve, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# =========================================================================
# How large a training set would the plug-in (PE) need to match the net
# benefit the posterior mean (PM) already achieves at size n0?
#
# NB_inf is the candidate model's net-benefit ceiling, estimated directly from
# the full cohort (gusto_nb_inf.rds, NB-summary chunk); prior-independent (one
# per threshold). The inverse-power learning curve (Figueroa) is
#   NB(n) = NB_inf - b * n^c,
# with NB_inf fixed; the decay exponent c is the log-log slope of the gap to the
# ceiling over the three sizes, and b is set by anchoring through the observed
# point at n0. n* (the plug-in size matching PM's NB at n0) is then
#   n* = n0 * [ (NB_inf - NB_PM(n0)) / (NB_inf - NB_PE(n0)) ]^(1/c),
# which reduces to the 1/n form at c = -1 and is sign-consistent with NB_PM-NB_PE.
# =========================================================================
lc_dat <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "gusto_nb_pm_pe_diff.rds")) %>%
  dplyr::select(prior, prior_label, n, z, mean_pe, mean_pm) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prior_label = factor(prior_label, levels = unname(priors_nb)))

# Shared, prior-independent ceiling from the full-cohort model (per threshold)
nb_inf_tbl <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "gusto_nb_inf.rds"))
lc_dat     <- dplyr::left_join(lc_dat, nb_inf_tbl, by = "z")

# Decay exponent c per (prior, z): slope of log(NB_inf - NB_PE(n)) ~ log(n) over
# the three sizes. Guard: c >= 0 or non-finite (MC noise) -> fall back to c = -1.
c_fit <- lc_dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(prior_label, z) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(c_exp = {
      g <- nb_inf - mean_pe; ok <- is.finite(g) & g > 0
      if (sum(ok) >= 2) unname(coef(lm(log(g[ok]) ~ log(n[ok])))[2]) else NA_real_
    }, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(c_exp = ifelse(is.finite(c_exp) & c_exp < 0, c_exp, -1))

# Anchored power-law n* at each reference size n0 (uses observed NB at n0)
nstar_tbl <- lc_dat %>%
  dplyr::left_join(c_fit, by = c("prior_label", "z")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(n0 = n, nb_pm_n0 = mean_pm, nb_pe_n0 = mean_pe) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nstar = dplyr::case_when(
              (nb_inf - nb_pm_n0) <= 0 ~ Inf,        # PM at/above ceiling
              (nb_inf - nb_pe_n0) <= 0 ~ NA_real_,   # PE at/above ceiling at n0 (noise)
              TRUE ~ n0 * ((nb_inf - nb_pm_n0) / (nb_inf - nb_pe_n0))^(1 / c_exp)
            ),
    extra_n = nstar - n0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nstar   = round(nstar),
    extra_n = round(extra_n)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(z, prior_label, n0, nb_pe_n0, nb_pm_n0, nb_inf, c_exp,
                nstar, extra_n) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(z, match(prior_label, unname(priors_nb)), n0)

saveRDS(nstar_tbl, file.path(res_dir, "gusto_nstar_learning_curve.rds"))

knitr::kable(
  nstar_tbl,
  digits    = c(2, 0, 0, 4, 4, 4, 2, 0, 0),
  col.names = c("z", "Prior", "n0", "NB(PE,n0)", "NB(PM,n0)",
                "NB ceiling", "c", "n*", "extra n"),
  caption   = paste("GUSTO: plug-in training size n* whose net benefit matches",
                    "the posterior mean at n0, from an inverse-power learning",
                    "curve (NB ceiling = full-cohort model; c = fitted decay",
                    "exponent, prior-independent ceiling).")
)
```







## Brute-force backbone: PE net benefit at a candidate training size
```{r nb-pe-at-n, echo = FALSE}
# =========================================================================
# nb_pe_at_n(): mean plug-in (PE) net benefit at a candidate training size n,
# for one prior, over n_sim Monte-Carlo replicates. Reproduces the main GUSTO
# simulation exactly: same data (df_final), model spec (settings$fm_model),
# sampling (train on n drawn rows, evaluate on the complement), per-prior fit,
# and RAW net-benefit definition (threshold uses strict >, no /prevalence).
# PE only, no MCMC -> cheap enough to sweep many n as the backbone of a
# brute-force search for n* (the size at which NB_PE(n*) = NB_PM(n0)).
#
#   n      : candidate training size (must be < nrow(data))
#   n_sim  : number of Monte-Carlo replicates
#   prior  : "f" (flat MLE), "j" (Jeffreys/Firth), "lf" (log-F), "br" (Bayes ridge)
#   z      : decision threshold(s); scalar or vector (default settings$z)
# Returns a data.frame, one row per z: prior, n, z, n_sim, nb_pe (mean), se.
# =========================================================================
nb_pe_at_n <- function(n, n_sim, prior, z = settings$z,
                       data   = df_final,
                       fm     = settings$fm_model,
                       logf_m = settings$logf_m,
                       seed   = settings$seed) {
  z <- as.numeric(z)
  N <- nrow(data)
  stopifnot(prior %in% c("f", "j", "lf", "br"), n >= 1, n < N, n_sim >= 1)

  # Fitted candidate coefficients for the chosen prior (matches the sim loop).
  fit_coef <- function(df_samp, mm_samp) {
    switch(prior,
      f  = coef(glm(fm, data = df_samp, family = binomial())),
      j  = coef(update(glm(fm, data = df_samp, family = binomial()),
                       method = "brglmFit", type = "AS_mean")),
      lf = coef(logf_glm(mm_samp, df_samp$Y, m = logf_m)),
      br = bayesian_ridge(mm_samp, df_samp$Y)$beta
    )
  }
  # Raw net benefit at threshold zz (GUSTO scale: strict >, minus treat-all/none).
  nb_raw <- function(preds, y, zz) {
    nbt <- y - (1 - y) * zz / (1 - zz)
    mean((preds > zz) * nbt) - max(0, mean(nbt))
  }

  vals <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(z), ncol = n_sim)
  for (i in seq_len(n_sim)) {
    set.seed(seed + i)                       # reproducible, distinct per replicate
    ids     <- sample(N, n)
    df_samp <- data[ids, , drop = FALSE]
    df_pop  <- data[-ids, , drop = FALSE]
    mm_samp <- model.matrix(fm, df_samp)
    mm_pop  <- model.matrix(fm, df_pop)
    b       <- fit_coef(df_samp, mm_samp)
    preds   <- plogis(as.numeric(mm_pop %*% b))
    vals[, i] <- vapply(z, function(zz) nb_raw(preds, df_pop$Y, zz), numeric(1))
  }
  data.frame(prior = prior, n = n, z = z, n_sim = n_sim,
             nb_pe = rowMeans(vals),
             se    = apply(vals, 1L, sd) / sqrt(n_sim))
}

# --- Example brute-force usage (not run on render) -----------------------
# Sweep n around a learning-curve guess and locate the crossing NB_PE(n) =
# NB_PM(n0); compare the empirical n* to the curve-based n* in nstar_tbl.
#
# grid <- seq(250, 1200, by = 50)
# sweep <- do.call(rbind, lapply(grid, nb_pe_at_n, n_sim = 2000, prior = "f", z = 0.02))

#                              nstar_tbl$z == 0.02 & nstar_tbl$n0 == 250]
```

## Supplementary: Monte Carlo standard errors of the simulation results

```{r gusto-se-tables, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# =========================================================================
# Monte Carlo SE of each summary plotted in the main GUSTO figures, by metric,
# method (prior x prediction type, plus the frequentist-ridge and MCMC-ridge
# comparators), and training size n. SE matches the plotted central statistic:
#   - mean-summarised metrics (MSE, C-statistic): SE = sd / sqrt(n_rep)
#   - median-summarised metrics (O/E ratio, calibration slope): bootstrap SE of
#     the median.
# For sNB we also tabulate the SE of the paired difference Delta-NB = NB(PM) -
# NB(PE) for the four priors. (D_KL is unavailable for GUSTO: no simulated true
# risk.) Saved to RDS for the Supplement.
# =========================================================================
res <- readRDS(file.path(res_dir, "sim_gusto_results.RDS"))

se_methods <- c("pe_f","pm_f","pe_j","pm_j","pe_lf","pm_lf","pe_br","pm_br",
                "pe_ridge_min","pm_br_mcmc")
prior_of   <- c(pe_f="Flat", pm_f="Flat", pe_j="Jeffreys", pm_j="Jeffreys",
                pe_lf="log-F", pm_lf="log-F", pe_br="Bayesian ridge", pm_br="Bayesian ridge",
                pe_ridge_min="Ridge (CV-min)", pm_br_mcmc="Bayesian ridge (MCMC)")
center_map <- c(mse="mean", cstat="mean", oe_ratio="median", cal_slp="median")
metric_lab <- c(mse="MSE", cstat="C-statistic", oe_ratio="O/E ratio", cal_slp="Calibration slope")
prior_lv   <- c("Flat","Jeffreys","log-F","Bayesian ridge","Ridge (CV-min)","Bayesian ridge (MCMC)")
# prior-code -> label (defined locally so this chunk is self-contained)
priors_nb  <- c(f="Flat", j="Jeffreys", lf="log-F", br="Bayesian ridge")

B_se  <- 1000
se_of <- function(v, ctr) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (length(v) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (ctr == "mean") return(sd(v) / sqrt(length(v)))
  sd(vapply(seq_len(B_se), function(b) median(sample(v, length(v), replace = TRUE)), numeric(1)))
}
# central estimate whose SE we report (mean or median, matching the figure)
ctr_of <- function(v, ctr) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return(NA_real_)
  if (ctr == "mean") mean(v) else median(v)
}

# --- Statistical metrics ---
set.seed(settings$seed)
gusto_se_stat <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% names(center_map),
         as.character(method) %in% se_methods) %>%
  mutate(metric = as.character(metric), method = as.character(method)) %>%
  group_by(metric, method, n) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = ctr_of(value, center_map[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            se    = se_of(value,  center_map[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior  = factor(prior_of[method], levels = prior_lv),
         type   = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "PM", "PE"),
         metric = factor(metric_lab[metric], levels = unname(metric_lab))) %>%
  arrange(metric, prior, type, n)
saveRDS(gusto_se_stat, file.path(res_dir, "gusto_se_stat.rds"))

# --- sNB: per-method SE (mean) by method x n x threshold ---
nb_metrics <- grep("^nb", unique(as.character(res$metric)), value = TRUE)
gusto_se_snb <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% nb_metrics, as.character(method) %in% se_methods) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method), z = as.numeric(sub("^nb", "", metric))) %>%
  group_by(method, n, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(value))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior_of[method], levels = prior_lv),
         type  = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "PM", "PE")) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, type, n)
saveRDS(gusto_se_snb, file.path(res_dir, "gusto_se_snb.rds"))

# --- Delta-NB = PM - PE (paired) SE, four priors ---
gusto_se_dnb <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% nb_metrics,
         as.character(method) %in% c("pe_f","pm_f","pe_j","pm_j","pe_lf","pm_lf","pe_br","pm_br")) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         estimator = ifelse(startsWith(method, "pm_"), "pm", "pe"),
         prior = sub("^p[me]_", "", method),
         z = as.numeric(sub("^nb", "", metric))) %>%
  select(iteration, n, z, prior, estimator, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = estimator, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(is.finite(pe), is.finite(pm)) %>%
  group_by(prior, n, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep   = dplyr::n(),
            est     = mean(pm - pe),
            se_diff = sd(pm - pe) / sqrt(n_rep), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior_label = factor(unname(priors_nb[prior]), levels = prior_lv)) %>%
  arrange(z, prior_label, n) %>%
  select(prior_label, n, z, n_rep, est, se_diff)   # prior_label first; drop prior code
saveRDS(gusto_se_dnb, file.path(res_dir, "gusto_se_dnb.rds"))

knitr::kable(head(gusto_se_stat, 10), digits = 5,
             caption = "Preview: GUSTO Monte Carlo SE (statistical metrics)")
```


```{r gusto-se-comp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =========================================================================
# SE table for the three PM computation methods:
#   exact  = Gauss-Hermite quadrature  (pm_f, pm_j, pm_lf, pm_br)
#   mk     = MacKay approximation       (pm_*_mk)
#   pp     = Self-projection            (pm_*_pp)
# Covers all four priors x three n-values x all metrics (stat + sNB).
# Saved to gusto_se_comp.rds for the Supplement.
# =========================================================================
comp_methods_all <- c("pm_f","pm_f_mk","pm_f_pp",
                      "pm_j","pm_j_mk","pm_j_pp",
                      "pm_lf","pm_lf_mk","pm_lf_pp",
                      "pm_br","pm_br_mk","pm_br_pp")
# keep only methods present in the results (in case some were disabled)
comp_methods_avail <- intersect(comp_methods_all, unique(as.character(res$method)))

comp_of_method <- function(m) {
  parts <- strsplit(m, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) <= 2) "exact" else parts[3]
}
prior_of_comp <- setNames(
  rep(c("Flat","Jeffreys","log-F","Bayesian ridge"), each = 3),
  c("pm_f","pm_f_mk","pm_f_pp",
    "pm_j","pm_j_mk","pm_j_pp",
    "pm_lf","pm_lf_mk","pm_lf_pp",
    "pm_br","pm_br_mk","pm_br_pp"))

# --- Statistical metrics ---
set.seed(settings$seed)
gusto_se_comp_stat <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% names(center_map),
         as.character(method) %in% comp_methods_avail) %>%
  mutate(metric = as.character(metric), method = as.character(method)) %>%
  group_by(metric, method, n) %>%
  summarise(est = ctr_of(value, center_map[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            se  = se_of (value, center_map[[dplyr::first(metric)]]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior        = factor(prior_of_comp[method], levels = prior_lv),
         comp         = vapply(method, comp_of_method, character(1)),
         metric_label = factor(metric_lab[metric], levels = unname(metric_lab))) %>%
  select(metric_label, prior, n, comp, est, se) %>%
  arrange(metric_label, prior, n, comp)

# --- sNB ---
gusto_se_comp_snb <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% nb_metrics,
         as.character(method) %in% comp_methods_avail) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z = as.numeric(sub("^nb", "", metric))) %>%
  group_by(method, n, z) %>%
  summarise(n_rep = sum(is.finite(value)),
            est   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            se    = sd(value,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(value))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior_of_comp[method], levels = prior_lv),
         comp  = vapply(method, comp_of_method, character(1))) %>%
  select(z, prior, n, comp, est, se) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, n, comp)

# --- sNB paired deltas: MacKay - exact and self-proj - exact ---
gusto_se_comp_snb_delta <- res %>%
  filter(as.character(metric) %in% nb_metrics,
         as.character(method) %in% comp_methods_avail) %>%
  mutate(method = as.character(method),
         z      = as.numeric(sub("^nb", "", metric)),
         prior  = prior_of_comp[method],
         comp   = vapply(method, comp_of_method, character(1))) %>%
  select(prior, n, z, iteration, comp, value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = comp, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(is.finite(exact)) %>%
  group_by(prior, n, z) %>%
  summarise(
    est_mk = mean(mk   - exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_mk  = sd(mk     - exact, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(mk   - exact))),
    est_pp = mean(pp   - exact, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_pp  = sd(pp     - exact, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(is.finite(pp   - exact))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prior = factor(prior, levels = prior_lv)) %>%
  arrange(z, prior, n)

saveRDS(list(stat = gusto_se_comp_stat, snb = gusto_se_comp_snb,
             snb_delta = gusto_se_comp_snb_delta),
        file.path(res_dir, "gusto_se_comp.rds"))

cat("Computation-comparison SE: stat rows =", nrow(gusto_se_comp_stat),
    "| snb rows =", nrow(gusto_se_comp_snb),
    "| snb_delta rows =", nrow(gusto_se_comp_snb_delta), "\n")
cat("Methods found:", paste(sort(comp_methods_avail), collapse=", "), "\n")
```
